title: Add shaderng to an Angular application

project.description: The application project to install into. Defaults to the first application in angular.json.

orbs.description: Comma-separated orb slugs to copy right away (orb-01 … orb-33), "all", or empty for none.
orbs.x-prompt: Which orbs should be copied now? (comma-separated slugs like orb-01,orb-07, "all", or leave empty)

force.description: Overwrite runtime files and orbs that already exist in the project.

skipInstall.description: Add the dependencies to package.json without running the package manager.
